news.headline: Physical activity may protect against depression for people at genetic risk
news.summary:
Denver Brown, in kinesiology, studies whether physical activity protects against depression.
The work looks especially at people with a genetic risk for depression.

news.headline: NIH asks for ideas to reduce administrative burden in grants
news.summary:
NIH is asking researchers and research administrators where its grant requirements add work without adding value.
Comments can cover steps to simplify or drop, duplicated requirements, unclear rules, and reports that are collected but never used.
Early Stage Investigators and smaller institutions are named as groups that may carry more of the burden.
Responses are due December 8, 2026, through the NIH request-for-information portal.
NIH may post responses publicly, so leave out unpublished or sensitive details.

news.headline: K-State members can search for funding with Atom Grants
news.summary:
K-State now provides Atom Grants, a tool that matches researchers to funding opportunities from a plain-language description of their work.
It sends weekly emails about matching opportunities and lists each announcement's key requirements.
Sign in at atomgrants.com with your eID@ksu.edu address, at no cost.

opportunities.name: Higuchi-KU Endowment Research Achievement Awards
opportunities.sponsor: University of Kansas Office of Research and KU Endowment
opportunities.summary:
Faculty at any Kansas Board of Regents university can be nominated by a colleague.
One award is in the biomedical sciences and one is in the basic sciences.
Nominations are due December 15, 2026.
